sentences.text: Such being the case, if the car was driven by its driver cautiously, taking necessary precautions he could have certainly avoid the occurrence of accident.

These factors come to the aid of respondent No.3 as the sketch furnished in this case substantiates the oral evidence given by PW.1 to PW.3 as sketch reflects that the offending bus in question was halted near the divider of the road and that towards its left some 8 mts. Width of road was open for movement of the vehicles.
One more important aspect to be noted here is that the accident admittedly occurred in a straight road.
Such being the case, from the case papers it becomes clear that the car driver has driven the same in that road towards the right side edge of the road and dashed to the hind portion of the bus.
Normally, the vehicle movements will be towards the left edge of the road.
As the driver of the car has chosen the right side edge of the road, it appears that due to his negligence the accident occurred.
Apart from this, it is also to be noted that the driver of offending bus had not halted the bus intentionally for any other purpose.

But, as per the recitals of the documents placed on hand,
same was halted as a result of puncture of its tyre.

Even assuming for a moment that the driver of the bus had parked the same at the right edge of the road i.e., next to the divider, as the records show that there was some 20 ft. width space available towards the left of the bus, the driver of car if had taken any precautions/if the car was driven cautiously certainly he could have avoided the occurrence of accident.
